subject: Human Body
title: Where Digestion Begins
description: A fast breakdown of Where Digestion Begins for builders.

hook.text: Digestion doesn't start in the stomach. It starts the instant food touches your tongue.

buildup.text: Saliva floods your mouth within seconds. It contains enzymes that begin breaking down starch into sugar.

discovery.text: Amylase, the key enzyme in saliva, starts digesting carbs before you even swallow.

twist.text: You produce about 1.5 liters of saliva daily. Without it, you couldn't taste, swallow, or even speak clearly.

climax.text: The mouth is a chemical factory, not just a chewing machine. Digestion is already underway before food leaves it.

punchline.text: Your mouth doesn't just eat food. It starts digesting it.

quiz.question: Which enzyme in saliva begins breaking down starch?
